content.prompt:
Draw the following on the number line.
$$(-1,2]$$

answer.worked: The round bracket excludes $-1$ and the square bracket includes 2. Join an open circle at $-1$ to a filled dot at 2.

spec.description: Double-arrow axis labelled −2 through 3; raised segment from open −1 to filled 2.
